entities.summary: Alexander Nedeljkovic (Serbian Cyrillic: Александар Недељковић, romanized: Aleksandar Nedeljković is an American professional ice hockey player who is a goaltender for the San Jose Sharks of the National Hockey League. Nedeljkovic was selected by the Carolina Hurricanes in the second round of the 2014 NHL entry draft.
